about: The redirect fixer's limits and word lists. scripts/redirect_plan.py reads this file, so change a rule here and nowhere else. Each key is explained under notes; SKILL.md says how the plan's checks stop or warn.

notes.max_changes_per_batch: At most this many changes go into one plan and one confirmation. The rest are listed as deferred, for the next batch.
notes.redirect_min_revenue: A redirect on a search (or, for a phrase match, on a longer search it would catch) that earned at least this much revenue in the performance window takes those shoppers away from products: warning. Same value as discovery-change-qa.
notes.broad_query_max_words: A phrase-match redirect on a keyword with this many words or fewer catches many longer searches: warning. Same value as discovery-change-qa.
notes.max_query_chars: Discovery rejects redirect keywords longer than this many characters: blocker.
notes.sync_checks: After each write, read the rule back up to this many times (a few seconds apart) until syncStatus is SUCCESS, before reporting it as done.
notes.placeholder_url_words: Text in a destination URL's path or query that suggests it isn't finished (compared lower-case): blocker. Same list as discovery-change-qa.
notes.placeholder_hosts: Destination hosts that are never a real page: blocker.
